prompts.prompt: Create a production source layer for a 2D cutout sprite animation, editing the supplied approved mushroom nest. The reference is the exact design authority. Output ONE 512 by 512 full-canvas RGBA image, transparent outside the asset. Remove BOTH coral-red mushroom caps entirely, including their undersides, and reconstruct the complete cream-colored stems which the caps used to occlude. Keep the original cream nest rim, the three coral eggs, the lighting, dark teal thin outlines, exact camera, silhouette of the grounded bowl, and positions pixel-registered. The main stem must be a complete smoothly widening cream stalk behind the eggs, rising to the original main canopy attachment around (256,220). The smaller rear stalk on the right must be complete as well. This is a hidden-surface/body layer used UNDER separately animated original cap layers. Draw real finished hidden surfaces with consistent warm cream shading; do not smear, blur, leave holes, or put a flat rectangle behind the nest. No caps, extra mushrooms, particles, shadows outside the original footprint, text, borders, labels or checkerboard. Preserve the lower half of the approved design precisely. This is final animation source artwork, not a mockup.

Create a hidden background plate for the approved 2D stone nest in the reference. This is final source artwork for a layered rigid-stone animation. Output ONE 512 by 512 transparent RGBA full-canvas source layer. Keep the exact reference camera and scale. Remove the roof slab, the small stone atop it, all four front structural support stones, and the small pebbles along the bottom foreground. In their place draw the COMPLETE hollow cave interior behind those stones: deep warm ochre/brown faceted rear wall, darker top and sides, amber lit floor. Extend this hidden interior plate smoothly over the entire area behind the original arch from approximately x85 to445 and y260 to440, so slightly rotating individual foreground stones exposes finished natural brown interior rather than transparency. No visible exterior facade or new stones. Retain the original cave floor perspective and lighting, no change of ground height, no added props, eyes, face, glow, magic or particles. Preserve the illustrated broad faceted material and thin dark teal edge language of the original. Clean soft exterior alpha only where the hidden plate ends, with no white matte or checkerboard. No text or labels.

Create a PRODUCTION LAYER ATLAS for the exact approved cyan water nest, for a flowing-water 2D idle animation. Transparent RGBA background. Output a precise 4-column by 2-row grid of eight equal square cells, no borders, no gaps, no labels, no text. Each cell shows ONE separated source item, NOT a complete pose unless specified. Preserve the original turquoise/cyan painterly 2D shading and thin dark teal contour; keep the same view and lighting. Grid reading order:
cell 1: the complete original nest with ONLY the short falling curtain of water between upper pool and lower pool removed and the water surface underneath reconstructed cleanly. Keep the outer silhouette and both pools and their lip positions exactly registered to the reference; remove the frozen bright rings on the lower pool's center, leaving smooth turquoise water there. This is a stationary clean plate.
cells 2,3,4,5: four successive looping drawings of ONLY that short falling water curtain, isolated, same silhouette bounding box and same width in all four cells. The top is a broad curved lip, the bottom a softly scalloped falling edge. Show distinct bright ribbons advecting DOWN the sheet from frame to frame, changing their curving continuity and small lower-edge drips as water flows, then seamlessly returns to the first. Do not move or rotate the entire curtain; convey flowing liquid with changing rib shapes and highlights. No pools or nest in these four cells, only the separated water ribbon.
cell 6: one isolated delicate cyan-white elliptical impact ripple ring, shallow perspective ellipse, softly tapered ends, transparent inside and outside, matching the lower pool highlights.
cell 7: one isolated partial elliptical ripple arc, slightly broader than cell 6, matching the same water material, transparent inside/outside.
cell 8: only the upper pool's inner turquoise elliptical water surface with a subtle bright rotating-current highlight, isolated from its thick outer lip.
All separated items must be drawn complete with alpha padding, no clipping. The isolated elements can be centered in their own cells for clean extraction. No newly added objects, vegetation, fountains, bubbles, sparkles, pipes, stone, droplets outside the original nest footprint, checkerboard or matte. These layers will be placed and animated over the ORIGINAL fixed nest perimeter; consistency is essential.

Create ONE finished cutout source layer for animating the approved golden stone nest in the reference. Output a 512x512 transparent RGBA canvas, exact same camera and pixel placement as the reference. Keep ONLY the broad horizontal roof slab. Remove the small top capstone, all four side support stones, tiny ground pebbles, and cave interior. Reconstruct the roof surface that the capstone hid, continuing the existing golden sandstone facets coherently. The roof must be a complete thick rigid boulder, including its dark ochre underside edge. Preserve its exact approved silhouette, asymmetric tilt, faceted color fields, lighting, thin dark teal outline and on-canvas coordinates. No redesign, no new cracks, symbols or props. This is a separated roof attachment used under an independently moving capstone, so the entire roof must remain solid behind the capstone's original position. Preserve transparency, do not add ground shadow, text, panel, grid, checkerboard or matte.

Create a two-cell horizontal atlas of COMPLETE separated mushroom cap attachments for the approved 2D mushroom nest in the reference. Exactly TWO equal square cells side by side, transparent background, no labels, no borders, no text. Left cell: ONLY the large main coral cap, complete upper shell AND the full deep red undulating underside. Right cell: ONLY the small rear coral cap, complete shell and underside. Remove ALL cream-colored stems, nest rim and eggs. Each cap must be drawn complete including the parts hidden behind the cream stem and nest rim; do NOT leave a stem-shaped cutout, jagged notch, white fragments, or detached slivers in either cap. The lower contour should be a continuous natural scalloped red underside, with no hole punched into its center. Match the EXACT reference designs, soft coral highlights, dark burgundy undersides, asymmetrical wavy rims, thin dark teal outline, same painterly 2D style and lighting. Keep the same viewing angle. Isolate and center each complete cap in its own square with padding. This is production SOURCE ART used to rig the two mushroom caps independently over a separately completed cream body. No stems or other objects anywhere.
